elements.name: a2b
elements.text:
1. Make beam width adaptive to candidate diversity and recent residual progress.
2. Trigger refinement earlier when coarse progress plateaus.
3. Rank lexicographically: max|h| → L₂(h) → objective.
4. Normalize runtime comparisons across hardware/backends.
5. Use SQP/interior-point as deterministic validation references.
